europe_now.title: Major security incident at UK air base
europe_now.summary: UK police evacuated homes and made multiple arrests for suspected explosive offenses near an air base utilized by US forces. Bomb disposal teams were deployed to examine vehicles in the area.

sources.headline: UK: Several arrested as bomb disposal team examines vehicles
Major incident declared at UK air base used by US forces

europe_now.title: Lithuania debates nuclear policy shift
europe_now.summary: Lithuania has initiated moves to lift its existing ban on nuclear weapons amid heightened regional security concerns. Officials defended the policy shift by asserting that opposing forces do not attack strong nations.

sources.headline: Lithuania moves to lift ban on nuclear weapons as ‘Russians do not attack the strong’

top_stories.title: Papal visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV continued his apostolic journey in France with events in Lourdes after drawing large crowds in Paris. During the visit, he addressed church failings and met with abuse survivors.

sources.headline: Pope Leo continues his visit to France in Lourdes

top_stories.title: Housing protests in Spain
top_stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators took to the streets in Madrid over the housing crisis and recent evictions. Citizens expressed mounting frustration regarding social challenges and living costs.
